rationale: Draft's core claims are grounded: chunk 1801617199380648-1 confirms mythic uniques were 'way too rare'; chunk 1801617199380648-5 confirms removal of item class restrictions ('Astramentis is now the same rarity as a weapon like Mjolner'), rarity scaling adjustment ('Common uniques get less common as more Rarity is added'), and mythic drop rate buff ('massively buff the number of Mythic Uniques'); chunk 1800357164550829-1 confirms socketables were introduced 'to help you out during your campaign progression to fill out any missing attributes or resists.'
